name: Hotel d’Inghilterra
insider_take: Where Roman royalty meets timeless elegance in the heart of the Eternal City's most prestigious shopping district.
whats_special: This legendary hotel has been hosting dignitaries since 1845, from Ernest Hemingway to Princess Diana. Located on the iconic Via Bocca di Leone, you're steps from the Spanish Steps and surrounded by haute couture boutiques like Gucci and Prada. The hotel's rooftop terrace offers breathtaking views of Rome's ancient skyline, while its Michelin-recommended restaurant serves refined Italian cuisine in an intimate setting.
pro_tip: Book the Roman Penthouse Suite for exclusive access to a private terrace overlooking the Spanish Steps – perfect for sunset aperitivos with unparalleled city views.
dont_miss: The hotel's historic elevator, one of Rome's oldest still in operation, and the evening cocktail service on the rooftop where you can spot the dome of St. Peter's Basilica. Take advantage of the concierge's insider access to private Vatican tours and after-hours shopping at nearby luxury boutiques.
pros: Prime location near Via del Corso and Spanish Steps
Historic 15th-century palace with classic Roman elegance
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Beautifully appointed rooms with luxury amenities
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes
